name: push: a hint that says a wrong sum is never shown: the rung's safe line stands in, and the reason names the sum

in.line: Say you have k minus 3 equals 8. Adding 3 to both sides gives k equals 8 plus 3. So k is 12. The 3 was subtracted on the left, so it shows up added on the right; check whether your 6 did the same.
